$Comment: What a player sees and hears when standing earned past a reputation's top rank crosses another
multiple of its Beyond Every and the reward for it WAITS to be collected: it fires once per change
that adds a waiting reward, and the player collects it with the Collect button on that reputation's
Reputation page. A reputation whose Beyond says Collect false pays on the spot and raises none.
This is the library's own neutral default. A mod that ships a file with this same name in its own pack
replaces it (a pack that lists this library as a dependency loads after it), and a server owner can do
the same. Override the whole file rather than editing this one.
The moment carries 'name' (the reputation's name, in the reader's language), 'waiting' (how many of
its rewards wait in all) and the reputation id under 'source'; 'player' is always who earned it.
Key is a line from a .lang file and Args names which of those values fill its blanks, in order.
PlayerLevel true hands the toast to each player's own notification level, chosen on their Settings
tab. Tone colours the whole notification: gold Reward for a reward waiting to be collected.
